title: Noel Casler Says Miss Teen USA Lap-Dance Allegation Was Not a Joke
description_short: In a 2020 interview, Noel Casler said his Miss Teen USA lap-dance allegation was not a joke; the underlying event details remain unverified.
description_medium: In a Sept. 15, 2020 interview with writer Greg Olear, Noel Casler said, “When I talk about her giving her father a lap dance on Miss Teen USA, it’s not a joke.” He then pointed to a Mar-a-Lago photograph and said he thought it dated from 1996 and Ivanka was “15 or so.” The interview documents Casler’s allegation, not the alleged conduct or the photograph’s date and context.
description_long:
On September 15, 2020, writer Greg Olear published a second interview with Noel Casler, whom the article identifies as a comedian and talent handler who worked on Celebrity Apprentice for six seasons. In the Q&A, Casler said, “When I talk about her giving her father a lap dance on Miss Teen USA, it’s not a joke.” He then pointed to a Mar-a-Lago photograph showing Ivanka on her father’s lap, said he thought the photograph was from 1996, and described her as “15 or so.” This is Casler’s published allegation and his characterization of a photograph; it is not a contemporaneous account of the reported pageant episode.

The interview does not date a rehearsal, establish that the photograph was taken at Miss Teen USA, or independently verify Ivanka’s age. It provides no named contestant testimony, pageant record, or response from the people named. The supplied TrumpFile timeline was previously reported as dated August 20, 1997 and as placing the alleged request at rehearsals on the day of or shortly before the pageant; its supplied URL returned HTTP 403 in the prior retrieval attempt. This proposal therefore reports Casler’s words as an allegation and leaves the conduct, age, photograph context, and event date unverified.
